```{r setup, include = F}
# analysis
library(clusterProfiler)
library(viper)

# plotting
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(cowplot)

# databases
library(dorothea)

# tidyverse
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load helpers}
source("../R/helpers.R")
```

```{r load data}
source("../R/main-data.R")
```

```{r run viper}
# import dorothea data
source("../R/get-dorothea-regulons.R")

# run VIPER on all genes under IL1B stim
mat = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  select(Gene, time, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "time", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene")

hist(mat$`1`)
hist(mat$`2`)
hist(mat$`6`)
hist(mat$`12`)
hist(mat$`24`)

mat_viper = viper(
  mat, 
  dorothea_regulons[["viper_input"]]
  )

saveRDS(mat_viper, "../results/figure3/mat_viper.rds")

cleanup_objects()
```


```{r fig ???, fig.height=4, fig.width=3}
mat_viper = readRDS("../results/figure3/mat_viper.rds")

tfs_of_interest = mat_viper %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("tf") %>%
  group_by(tf) %>%
  mutate(abs = max(abs(c(`1`, `2`, `6`, `12`, `24`)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(abs, n = 20) %>%
  pull(tf)

top_tfs_mat = mat_viper[tfs_of_interest, ]

colors = circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(
    seq(-7, -1.5, length = 90),
    seq(-1.4, 1.4, length = 20),
    seq(1.4, 7, length = 90)
  ),
  colorRampPalette(
    c("orchid4", "orchid2", "white", "aquamarine2", "aquamarine4")
  )(200)
)

Heatmap(
  top_tfs_mat,
  cluster_columns = F,
  cluster_rows = T,
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  row_split = 7,
  col = colors,
  border = "black",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
  name = "NES",
  row_title = NULL,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = T
)

cleanup_objects()
```
